title: 第3章 孔夫子门前卖论语自不量力第4章 林筱这张嘴三句话两个坑实在阴险
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 黎阳低头见洛云卿瞪了他一眼不由得一愣。
怎么了？他说错什么了吗？
洛云卿摆手，“真的不用了，动用时光回溯镜还要耗费二长老的灵力，这丹药就让给芷晴师姐好了，我再撑一段时间可以的。”
二长老闻言倒是多看了洛云卿一眼，这女娃娃不错，会心疼人，知道动用法宝损耗他灵力，不像某些人，就知道占自家长老便宜……
林筱这时站出来，“那可不行，这么做多委屈云卿师妹啊，也还不了芷晴清白。”
“芷晴说不是她偷的丹药，那这丹药到底是怎么出现在芷晴修炼洞府的，总不能是它自己长脚跑过来的吧，我可好奇得很呐。”
洛云卿求助看向三长老，三长老神色阴沉的看着林筱，“云卿心善，都愿意把丹药给诗芷晴了，你还要做什么？你莫不是非要把诗芷晴赶出宗门才满意？”
这是转移仇恨？想把矛头转移到她身上。
林筱表示呵呵。
这些招都是她玩剩下的，跟她搞拉仇恨这一套，纯粹是孔夫子门前卖论语——自不量力。
林筱面无表情：“三长老说笑，弟子只是想帮芷晴洗脱冤屈，相信像三长老这样的正人君子，应该比弟子更想知道谁才是真正的小偷吧。”
“还是……三长老不想还芷晴清白？或者，三长老知道真凶是谁，所以才不敢让二长老使用时光回溯镜？”
“一派胡言！”
三长老一甩袖子厉喝道，“本长老怎么可能知道是谁偷了清心圣灵丹，更不可能包庇真凶！”
“那好！
那就二长老，请吧。”
林筱做了个请的手势，不顾对面三长老吃人的目光，她站姿挺立，就像一把已经出鞘的剑，锋芒毕露，气势如虹。
这番姿态不仅让三长老觉得奇怪，在场其余弟子也不禁多看了林筱两眼。
这还是他们那个沉默寡言的大师姐吗？什么时候变得这么有气势了？
洛云卿急得额头冒汗，三长老在她耳边传音道：“林筱估计是知道了点什么，你现在马上装作毒发样子，我先带你走，蒙混过关再说其他的。”
洛云卿万般不想这么做，这么做就意味着她得到诗芷晴根骨的事情泡汤了。
但事到如今，这也是没办法中的办法了。
都怪这个林筱！
洛云卿愤愤的瞪着林筱，如果不是她搅局，现在诗芷晴怕已经被逐出天衍宗了！
她记住她了！
林筱！
给她等着！
二长老取出时光回溯镜，就在他要施法时，洛云卿突然捂住心口，哇的吐出一大口血，然后缓缓的向后倒去。
三长老顺势接住洛云卿的身体，慌忙道：“云卿？云卿？！
肯定是血色蚀骨的毒又发作了，我先带云卿走了！”
不等周围人反应，三长老扶着洛云卿就要离开。
林筱这时又幽幽从后面开口：“等等。”
content_en:
Li Yang lowered his head and couldn't help but be startled when he saw Luo Yunqing glaring at him.
What's wrong? Did he say something wrong?
Luo Yunqing waved his hand, "It's really not necessary. Using the time-travel mirror will also consume the spiritual power of the second elder. I'll give this pill to Senior Sister Zhiqing. I can hold on for a while."
The second elder took a second look at Luo Yunqing when he heard this. This girl is good, she can feel sorry for others, and she knows how to use magic weapons to drain his spiritual power. Unlike some people, who only know how to take advantage of their elders...
Lin Xiao stood up at this time and said, "That's not okay. This will offend Junior Sister Yunqing a lot, and it won't clear Zhi Qing's innocence."
"Zhiqing said she didn't steal the elixir. So how did this elixir appear in Zhiqing's training cave? It couldn't have run here on its own. I'm very curious."
Luo Yunqing asked for help and looked to the third elder. The third elder looked at Lin Xiao with a gloomy expression, "Yunqing is kind-hearted and is willing to give the elixir to Shi Zhiqing. What else do you want to do? Do you have to drive Shi Zhiqing out of the sect to be satisfied?"
Is this a transfer of hatred? Want to shift the blame to her.
Lin Xiao said haha.
These tricks are all leftover from her tricks, and trying to attract hatred with her is just Confucius selling the Analects in front of his door - overestimating one's own capabilities.
Lin Xiao's face was expressionless: "The third elder is joking, the disciple just wants to help Zhi Qing clear her grievances. I believe that a gentleman like the third elder would want to know who the real thief is more than the disciple."
"Or... the third elder doesn't want to clear Zhi Qing's name? Or, the third elder knows who the real culprit is, so he doesn't dare to let the second elder use the time-travel mirror?"
"That's nonsense!"
The third elder shook his sleeves and shouted, "How could I possibly know who stole the Pure Heart Holy Spirit Pill, let alone cover up the real culprit!"
"That's good!
Then Second Elder, please. "
Lin Xiao made a gesture of invitation. Ignoring the cannibalistic gazes of the three elders opposite her, she stood upright, like a sword that had been unsheathed, with its sharp edge exposed and its momentum like a rainbow.
This gesture not only made the third elder feel strange, but also the other disciples present could not help but look at Lin Xiao twice.
Is this still their taciturn senior sister? When did you become so powerful?
Luo Yunqing was so anxious that sweat broke out on her forehead, and the third elder whispered in her ear: "Lin Xiao probably knows something. Now you pretend to be poisonous. I will take you away first, and we will talk about other things after you get through."
Luo Yunqing didn't want to do this at all. Doing so would mean that her chance to obtain Shi Zhiqing's bones would be ruined.
But now, this is no solution.
It’s all Lin Xiao’s fault!
Luo Yunqing glared at Lin Xiao angrily. If she hadn't disrupted the situation, Shi Zhiqing would have been expelled from Tianyan Sect by now!
She remembered her!
Lin Xiao!
Wait for her!
The second elder took out the time retrospective mirror, and just when he was about to cast a spell, Luo Yunqing suddenly covered his heart, spit out a large mouthful of blood, and then slowly fell backwards.
The third elder caught Luo Yunqing's body and said hurriedly: "Yun Qing? Yun Qing?!
The blood-colored bone-corrosive poison must have struck again. I'll take Yun Qing away first! "
Without waiting for the reaction of the people around him, the third elder supported Luo Yunqing and was about to leave.
Lin Xiao then spoke quietly from behind: "Wait a minute."
title_en: Chapter 3: Confucius sells the Analects in front of his house without knowing what he can do Chapter 4: Lin Xiao’s mouth is really insidious.
